row_order: ascending sort over all grouping keys (deterministic)

columns.name: week_start
columns.meaning: ISO Monday of the UTC post date (YYYY-MM-DD); empty means unknown period

columns.name: month
columns.meaning: first day of the UTC post month (YYYY-MM-01); empty means unknown period

columns.name: topic_id
columns.meaning: content topic notation (incl. unclassified); empty means missing

columns.name: intent_id
columns.meaning: content intent notation (incl. unclassified); empty means missing

columns.name: format_id
columns.meaning: content format notation; empty means missing

columns.name: post_count
columns.meaning: number of input posts in this group (>= 1)

unit: one row = one group of posts (never one post); sum(post_count) equals the input row count per file
observed_vs_derived: post_count and all bins are derived; period/compound/classification are observed group keys carried from the private input and collection metadata
not_present: no tweet_id_hash, author_id, text, URL, exact datetime, or exact engagement count appears in any column or value
